meta.name: frontend
meta.description: MUST USE for frontend/web UI/UX/visual work: building, styling, redesigning pages/components, React setup, performance audits, visual QA, taste, and polish. Routes four rulesets: design taste router and brand references; perfection for Playwright/Chromium Lighthouse/Core Web Vitals; ui-ux-db palettes/fonts/guidelines; designpowers personas/accessibility/critique/handoff; plus curl-only lazyweb real-app-screen research and the beui.dev interaction catalog. Triggers: frontend, UI, UX, design, redesign, styling, layout, animation, motion, interaction, micro-interaction, make it feel alive, premium, luxury, minimal, brutalist, Awwwards, DESIGN.md, mockup, React, Lighthouse, accessibility, WCAG, Core Web Vitals, looks generic, make it pretty, like X brand, lazyweb, design research.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 设计优质前端界面，整合品牌与性能标准
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要构建美观且高性能的前端界面
copy.tagline_en: Design high-quality frontend UI with brand and performance standards
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to build beautiful and high-performance frontend UI

howto.what: Claude 会先判断前端任务类型，加载对应规则集并说明；写界面代码前先建立设计规范（DESIGN.md），再按规范实现；完成后用真实浏览器做性能和无障碍审计，产出报告。
howto.when: 当用户要求做前端界面构建、样式调整、重新设计，或提到 'frontend'、'UI'、'design' 等触发词时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 React 做个登录页，先建 DESIGN.md
say.note: 会先建设计规范再写代码。

say.text: 对当前页面做 Lighthouse 审计，移动端和桌面端都要 100
say.note: 会用真实浏览器跑审计并出报告。

say.text: 把样式改成 Linear 品牌风格，先做设计研究和参考
say.note: 会加载品牌规则并做对比。

howto.what_en: Claude routes frontend tasks to the relevant rulesets and states which were loaded. Before any UI code, it requires a DESIGN.md spec, then builds against it. It audits performance and accessibility in a real browser and produces a report.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to build, style, or redesign web pages/components, do React work or performance audits, or mentions triggers like 'frontend', 'UI', 'design'.

say_en.text: Build a React login page and create DESIGN.md first.
say_en.note: Runs the design gate before coding.

say_en.text: Run a Lighthouse audit on this page, mobile and desktop, target 100.
Restyle it in Linear's brand language, starting with design research.
say_en.note: Loads brand tokens and logs research.
